$schema.description: Where an editor finds this file's schema.

about.description: What the file is, for its reader.

ignore.description: Files left out of the analysis, as globs from the root.

tiers.description: The tiers, top first within each group.

packages.description: Rules on workspace packages, by package name.

root.description: What the root manifest may declare.

Tier.description: One tier: where its modules are and what they may import.

group.description: The stack it belongs to (back, web, dev…), for the view.

criterion.description: What a module must meet to belong here.

paths.description: Where its modules are; a `*` segment makes one module per directory.

mayImport.description: The tiers its modules may import, its own included when peers may.

isolated.description: Set when two of its modules never import each other: the fix.

technologies.description: The technologies it may import; absent, any.

fix.description: The fix of an import it may not make.

typesFix.description: The fix of a value imported where only types may be.

technologyFix.description: The fix of a technology it may not use.

MayImport.description: A tier that may be imported, with its conditions.

anyOf.description: An import of that tier under conditions.

Condition.description: The conditions on importing a tier.

onlyFrom.description: Only these files (globs) may import it.

typesOnly.description: Only types may be imported from it.

PackageRule.description: What applies to one workspace package.

technologies.description: The technologies its files may import; absent, its tiers decide.

runOnly.description: Set when it is run and never imported: the fix.

RootRule.description: What the root manifest may declare.
